trans-unit.source: Show the field "Subheader tag" in content elements. If switched off, the subheader follows the tag of the header (one level below).

CSS selector of the content of the page, for example "main" or "#content". The headings in it are checked; of the headings in the header, the menu and the footer only the H1 counts. Without a match, or if empty (the default), the whole page is checked.

Allow the tag of a heading in the rich text of a content element to be changed in the box. The tag is changed in the stored text, at the place of the heading, and only to the headings the editor of the text offers. Off by default: the headings are only shown.
